ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Read the “Structure Diagram of the Shouguang Vegetable Industry Cluster.” <image1> The clustered production of vegetables in Shouguang causes related auxiliary industries and service departments to derive and cluster. According to the diagram, another type belonging to upstream enterprises of vegetable production is ________.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: at the center of the diagram is an oval frame “vegetable production base.” On the left there are multiple boxes connected to the center, including “intermediary service organization,” “seed and seedling company,” “agricultural means of production enterprise,” and “scientific research and training institution”; below there is also “government”; on the right there are “farmers” and “leading vegetable enterprises,” etc., connected to the center. Reasoning: the question asks to find “another type belonging to upstream enterprises of vegetable production.” According to the diagram, the upstream enterprises connected to the “vegetable production base” and located at the production input end include “agricultural means of production enterprise” and “seed and seedling company.” Since it asks for “another type,” one should fill in “seed and seedling company,” which is parallel to “agricultural means of production enterprise.”

raw_record.question_text:
Read the “Structure Diagram of the Shouguang Vegetable Industry Cluster.”

<image1>

The clustered production of vegetables in Shouguang causes related auxiliary industries and service departments to derive and cluster. According to the diagram, another type belonging to upstream enterprises of vegetable production is ________.

method.method_draft: 根据题干要求“属于蔬菜生产上游企业的另一类”，先在图中定位中心的“蔬菜生产基地”，再查找与其相连且位于生产投入端的企业方框。图中属于上游企业的两类是“农业生产资料企业”和“种子及种苗公司”。由于题干问“另一类”，应填写与“农业生产资料企业”并列的“种子及种苗公司”。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中中心是椭圆框“蔬菜生产基地”。左侧有多个与中心相连的方框，包括“中介服务组织”“种子及种苗公司”“农业生产资料企业”“科研、培训机构”，下方还有“政府”；右侧有“农户”和“蔬菜龙头企业”等与中心相连。推理：题目要求找“属于蔬菜生产上游企业的另一类”。按照图示，与“蔬菜生产基地”相连且位于生产投入端的上游企业有“农业生产资料企业”和“种子及种苗公司”。既然问“另一类”，应填写与“农业生产资料企业”并列的“种子及种苗公司”。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: 这是最直接的图读法：从产业集群结构图中按空间位置和箭头关系识别“蔬菜生产基地”的上游节点，再根据题干“另一类”选出与“农业生产资料企业”并列的另一个企业类别。
planner_metadata.image_role: 先观察图像：中心椭圆为“蔬菜生产基地”，其左侧有多个方框与中心相连，包括“中介服务组织”“种子及种苗公司”“农业生产资料企业”“科研、培训机构”；右侧还有“蔬菜龙头企业”，上方有“农户”，下方有“政府”。重点读取左侧与生产基地相连、属于生产投入来源的企业名称。
planner_metadata.text_role: 题干说明要读“寿光蔬菜产业集群结构图”，并限定答案为“属于蔬菜生产上游企业的另一类”，因此需要从图中提取企业类别，而不是回答服务部门或政府机构。
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: 运用产业链上下游概念：蔬菜生产的上游是为种植提供投入品或生产要素的部门；种子、种苗和农业生产资料都属于生产前端投入，而中介、科研培训、政府等更偏服务或支持部门。
